title: Phonetic profile is blind to the dental t-to-th operation
why_real: Gautam and Gautham are the same name under two romanizations, but Metaphone assigns the dental-aspirate spelling a different consonant skeleton, so a user who taught only 'Gautham' gets no help — by either retriever — when a dictation produces the plain 'Gautam'.

expected.reason: Metaphone keys for 'gautam' and 'gautham' do not intersect, so neither exact nor phonetic retrieves a candidate; both abstain no_memory.
